positive_snippets: Great stay. room was clean and good service
Clean rooms,polite staff and comfortable stay

Highly Recommended.

Found this stay very nice and cozy.

Ambience was so nice! Also the rooms were well equipped with amenities like locker, mini fridge, tv, free Wi-Fi, kettle, face mirror, etc

They have kept everything well maintained, no issues faced. Very clean and well maintained rooms. Everything was in working condition.

To top it all, food was too good - delicious, also the service was very nice with friendly and cooperative staff.

Location wise and from a safety perspective too the stay is well connected and located.
negative_snippets:
Absolutely Horrible Experience – Stay Away!

I stayed here for just a day and it was a complete nightmare. The service and condition of the hotel were beyond pathetic. Right from the start, the experience was a mess. The hotel owner at the reception was extremely rude and refused to let me check in just because I had booked the room at a discounted price. They insisted that I sort it out myself with the booking partner, completely washing their hands off the situation. I was left standing at the reception, tired and frustrated, wasting 1.5 hours trying to fix something that wasn’t even my fault.

Once I finally got into the room, things only got worse. There were no slippers, no soap, and the first thing I saw were bugs crawling on the floor. I immediately complained, but no one came to help. I even went down to the reception to request a room change or at least some kind of pest control, but again – absolutely no action was taken.

This hotel is a joke. The staff clearly doesn’t care, the cleanliness is non-existent, and the management is just plain awful. Save yourself the trouble – do not book this place, even if it looks like a good deal. It’s not worth the headache.
Unhygienic room. Mats were stained. A cockroach and a fly made themselves at home and refused to leave.
